concept: 2-in-1 running shorts — bioluminescent forest night trail checkpoint with floating pollen
negative_en: cartoon style, over-processed retouching, illustration look, distorted fingers, broken facial features, plastic-looking skin, fake-looking background, unrealistic hands
prompt_en:
Create a complex photorealistic full-body night-trail photograph of one unmistakably adult woman crossing a luminous trail checkpoint in a separated running stride. She wears 2-in-1 running shorts—two-in-one running shorts: one shared athletic waist system supports both short layers; a loose outer running-short shell forms its own two-leg silhouette; separately fitted inner shorts form two readable leg openings; outer-shell hems and longer inner-short hems remain simultaneously visible; a brief liner or single-layer color block cannot substitute for fitted inner shorts. Charcoal shell and teal inner shorts keep both layers distinct. The supplied portrait guides only the adult subject's facial proportions, long dark wavy hair, and general appearance. Wet roots, phosphorescent moss, markers, and layered trunks form a bioluminescent forest; floating pollen catches teal and amber light outside her silhouette. The waist, hips, both thighs, both leg openings, and every garment hem must remain fully visible and inspectable. Show her complete figure from head through both shoes, with her face readable. Keep checkpoint ribbons behind her upper body and the timing mat below her shoes, preserving unobstructed waist and thigh edges and crisp textile detail.
Avoid: cartoon style, over-processed retouching, illustration look, distorted fingers, broken facial features, plastic-looking skin, fake-looking background, unrealistic hands
